rows.definition: The internal/guardaccuracy package: a labeled command corpus (testdata/corpus.json, schema fak-guard-accuracy-corpus/1) that measures the guard reversibility preview classifier's accuracy. Each row pairs a (tool, args) command with the reversibility class the guard MUST assign, so a benign row escalated counts as a false positive and a dangerous row left reversible as a false negative; the corpus is grown as a ratchet - every wild misfire becomes a permanent row, never just a local test patch.
rows.distinction: guardaccuracy is neither the guard (the system) nor a gate (a decision point) - it is the ground-truth corpus that SCORES a gate's decision, yielding the classifier's false-positive / false-negative RATE. A guard runs the decision chain and a gate decides a single call; guardaccuracy measures how OFTEN that decision is right.
